avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer; significantly reduces abemaciclib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; use alternative herbal products if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; increases abemaciclib exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Do not consume grapefruit or grapefruit juice; consider other citrus alternatives

avoid_supplements.name: Kava kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer; may reduce abemaciclib bioavailability

caution_supplements.name: Goldenseal
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibitor; may increase abemaciclib levels modestly
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects if used; ensure adequate washout periods

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inducer; may slightly reduce abemaciclib concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor clinical response and adjust dosing if necessary

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases abemaciclib plasma concentration and adverse effect risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely eliminate from diet during treatment

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; may increase abemaciclib exposure
avoid_foods.action: Avoid or limit consumption; discuss alternatives with healthcare provider

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase abemaciclib absorption and GI side effects; food effect varies by formulation
caution_foods.action: Take with consistent meal pattern; avoid large high-fat meals if GI intolerance occurs

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, Brussels sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction; unlikely to significantly affect abemaciclib at normal dietary intake
caution_foods.action: No restriction needed; maintain normal vegetable consumption for nutritional benefit

monitoring_notes: Monitor CBC closely as abemaciclib is associated with neutropenia and diarrhea; dose adjustments may be needed with CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers. Counsel patient on strict avoidance of grapefruit and strong CYP3A4 inducers to maintain therapeutic drug exposure.
